answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 146558 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: What is our belief about Allah? Like Allah has mentioned in the Quran the following things about himself. (1) Hands and (2) Face etc. Please let us know. Question: What is our belief about Allah? Like Allah has mentioned in the Quran the following things about himself. (1) Hands and (2) Face etc. Please let us know. Answer ID: 146558 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 253/182/L=3/1438) It is necessary to believe in the qualities and attributes of Allah whatsoever has been mentioned about them in the Holy Quran and Hadith. However, its real condition should be entrusted to Allah, we must not enquire about them, this has been the way of Salaf and righteous elders. الاستواء معلوم والكيف مجهول ، والسوال عنه بدعة والإيمان به واجب .......وهذا طريقة السلف وهو أسلم . (شرح الفقه الاكبر: 46). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
